verdict.rationale: Notte is a cloud AI browser-automation platform that processes user data through LLMs, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no zero-retention guarantee. Vault credential isolation from LLMs and 'bring your own keys' are adjacent controls and do not establish that user data is excluded from model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
